name: session-board
description: A ticket board for all your Claude Code sessions, terminal and claude.ai/code cloud: what waits on you, what is in progress, what is left to do. Tickets come from hooks, from Claude (MCP tools) and from you.

server_url.title: Board server URL (optional)
server_url.description: Base URL of your session-board server, e.g. https://board.example.com. Leave empty for local mode (this machine only).

token.title: Board server token (optional)
token.description: Bearer token of your session-board server. Leave empty for local mode.
